summary: Phase 3 features (staffing calendar, bulk-assign post tasks + shots, deadline highlight, weekly PDF export) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (staffing calendar default & specific week + populated after deadline set; bulk-assign shots including non-member 400; bulk-assign post tasks with GET-verify persistence; past-deadline task flagged overdue in staffing; weekly JSON & PDF returning HTTP 200 + application/pdf + %PDF magic header). Frontend E2E: admin login → nav-staffing shows staffing-page + range label + prev/next/today changes range (14/09-20/09 → 21/09-27/09 → back); nav-reports Xuất PDF opens popup on /api/reports/weekly/pdf; DEMO-01 → Hậu kỳ creates 2 post tasks, checkboxes toggle bulk bar, assignee dropdown lists 7 members, apply gives toast 'Đã giao 2 task cho Studio Owner' and both rows show 'Studio Owner'; setting deadline to yesterday shows red 'Quá hạn' chip, +2 days shows amber 'Sắp tới hạn' chip; production board shows shot cards with amber/red deadline border styling on cards with near/overdue deadlines (SH-T-6cd2, SH-F-e27f, SH-F-cdd8 visible with colored border).
critical_code_review_comments: assignments.py bulk_assign_shots does not validate assignee_id membership when body.assignee_id is None (correct — unassign is allowed) but when it IS provided the check is enforced (400). Good.

post.py bulk_assign_tasks intentionally allows non-member assignee (no validation vs project.members). Contrast with single-shot assign_shot which rejects non-members. Consider aligning: for consistency, bulk-assign post tasks should also 400 on non-member assignee_id.
misc.py staffing_calendar `flag(deadline_day, status)`: DONE_STATES already contains both 'approved' and 'done'; the extra `status == 'done'` check is redundant. Minor.
reports_pdf: builds PDF server-side each request without caching; for large studios this could be slow. Consider ETag or short-term cache keyed on week+user.
Reports.jsx uses window.open(`${API_BASE}/reports/weekly/pdf`) — relies on httpOnly cookie being sent cross-site; verified working. No issue.

Staffing.jsx week-start computation uses local timezone (ISO date of local Monday) while backend interprets as UTC date via datetime.fromisoformat — potential off-by-one for users far from UTC. Not observed in test but worth aligning.
deadlineFlag helper only handles post statuses (approved/done); does not accept 'in_progress' vs 'review' distinctions, but that's correct per spec.
PostProduction bulk-assign: no confirmation dialog when Bỏ giao (unassign) selected. Acceptable UX but potentially destructive.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (staffing nav, bulk assign UI + toast, deadline chips, board border styling all verified)
